name: ploy
description: Ploy — marketing on autopilot. Create and steer Ploy agents, read workspaces, sites, documents, form submissions, visitors, and PloyDB data, upload attachments, and publish sites to production from ChatGPT or Codex.

interface.longDescription:
Ploy is an AI marketing platform that turns your website into a growth engine. Use Ploy in ChatGPT to build and improve your site, grow traffic, and turn more visitors into customers.
With Ploy, you can:
- Build and update pages that match your brand.
- Improve your website's visibility in search engines and AI answers.
- Create personalized landing pages for campaigns and target accounts.
- Review identified visitors and form submissions to find new leads.
- Run marketing workflows using your connected tools and business data.
Start a task, check its progress, and give Ploy feedback directly in your conversation. Review the results and publish site updates or growth workflows when you're ready.
Connect your Ploy account to get started.
defaultPrompt: Use Ploy to list my workspaces and sites.
Use Ploy to start an agent that drafts a landing page for our spring campaign.
Use Ploy to show the latest form submissions and identified visitors on my site.
